record.question: State True or False: A: The female bony pelvis is broader and flatter than the male pelvis. B: The pelvic inlet is narrower than the pelvic outlet.
record.explanation: Answer A: A-True, B- False. The female pelvis is generally broader and shallower than the male pelvis; the inlet is typically wider than the outlet, so statement A is true and B false. Source/context note: Pelvic morphology varies; the statement is an average anatomical comparison. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK537123/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
